nodes.description: Public mint price in wei (default 0.1 ether), read in mint and written by setPrice.
Public counter incremented on every successful mint in VERTest.
Boolean sale switch; gates mint and is toggled by flipSaleState.
IPFS base URI used by _baseURI/tokenURI.
Ownable owner address; used by onlyOwner and to bypass payment/balance checks in mint.
Counters.Counter tracking minted tokens in WithLimitedSupply; read/updated by RandomlyAssigned.nextToken.
Maximum token supply (7777) enforced by availability modifiers.
Mapping used by RandomlyAssigned to swap token indices for pseudo-random assignment.
Initial token id offset used by RandomlyAssigned.nextToken.
onlyOwner function that loops 75 times calling mint(msg.sender) to pre-mint tokens to the owner.
Public payable mint; checks supply, sale state and tx.origin, charges price for non-owners, calls nextToken then _safeMint.
onlyOwner setter for the mint price state variable.
onlyOwner toggle of saleIsActive.
onlyOwner payable function that forwards the whole contract balance using address.send.
RandomlyAssigned.nextToken override: derives a pseudo-random index from block values, swaps tokenMatrix entries and increments the counter.
ERC721 internal safe mint that mints and then verifies the receiver hook.
ERC721 private function performing the external onERC721Received call to the recipient contract.
Caller address, attacker controlled; used for ownership checks, balances, refund recipient and reserve loop target.
Transaction origin, attacker controlled; compared against msg.sender to block contract callers.
Miner-influenced block timestamp fed into the pseudo-random seed of RandomlyAssigned.nextToken.
External call to IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on the recipient, executed before state is fully settled in mint.
Pseudo-randomness derived from keccak256(msg.sender, block.coinbase, block.difficulty, block.gaslimit, block.timestamp) which is predictable/manipulable.
Low-level address.send of the full contract balance inside withdraw.
Access control relying on tx.origin == msg.sender to forbid contract callers.
tokenCount()+1 and availableTokenCount()-1 arithmetic used for supply bound checks in mint.
Recipient address parameter of mint; determines the safe-mint target and triggers the receiver callback.
New price parameter of setPrice.
Local token id returned by nextToken and passed to _safeMint in mint.
Local totalSupply()-tokenCount() value used as modulus and matrix index in nextToken.
Local pseudo-random index computed from block values in nextToken.
Loop counter local variable in reserve.

edges.reason: msg.sender is attacker controlled and drives the owner bypass and balanceOf checks inside mint.
msg.sender is the payable recipient of the balance sent in withdraw.
msg.sender is used as the mint recipient inside the reserve loop.
tx.origin feeds the tx.origin == msg.sender authorization check.
block.timestamp is part of the pseudo-random seed, giving timestamp dependency.
startFrom is added to the resulting token id in nextToken.
tokenMatrix is read and written during the random index assignment.
_totalSupply (via totalSupply()) is used to compute maxIndex in nextToken.
_tokenCount (via tokenCount()) is used to compute maxIndex and is incremented in nextToken.
price is read in the msg.value >= price check of mint.
currentSupply is incremented after each mint.
saleIsActive gates whether mint can be executed.
_owner is compared with msg.sender to skip payment and wallet-limit checks in mint.
setPrice writes the price state variable.
flipSaleState writes the saleIsActive state variable.
_to parameter flows into balanceOf(_to) and the _safeMint call in mint.
_newPrice parameter is assigned to the price state variable.
Local id from nextToken is passed to _safeMint, which triggers the receiver callback.
maxIndex local is used as the modulo bound and matrix index in nextToken.
random local is used to index tokenMatrix in nextToken.
Loop counter a controls the 75 iterations calling mint in reserve.
The token id returned by nextToken is used as the minted token id in mint.
reserve (onlyOwner) invokes mint repeatedly, bypassing the sale/payment path as owner.
mint executes tokenCount()+1 and availableTokenCount()-1 supply arithmetic for its bounds checks.
mint executes the tx.origin == msg.sender authorization check.
mint calls _safeMint, entering the receiver-callback code path.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received to validate the recipient contract.
withdraw executes the low-level send of the contract balance.
nextToken executes the weak randomness computation seeded by block values.
_checkOnERC721Received performs the external onERC721Received callback on the recipient.
The recipient callback can re-enter mint before the mint state is finalized.
